claim.proposition: Configured accepted observations produce the expected threshold, application-state, and visible-UI behavior.
claim.assuranceTarget: Application state model and visible UI

supportedInterpretation: For the recorded configuration and inputs, accepted semantic observations produced the expected application-state transitions and visible UI states.
exclusions: This assessment does not support BLE discovery, connection, subscription, notification-delivery, payload-decoding, radio, or peripheral-integration claims.
residualUncertainty: The catalog contains identified properties and may omit unknown dependencies.
Behavior outside the recorded inputs, versions, and observation bounds was not evaluated.
